page.overview:
Who is Kie Kamado?

Kie was a woman with a noticeably light complexion. She had kind and white-pupiled eyes, whose irises were black at the top and purple at the bottom. She also possessed a small beauty mark beneath the left side of her lower lip. Kie had black hair, worn in a messy bun with a few loose strands left to dangle over her face. Her eldest daughter Nezuko bears a striking resemblance to her, especially in facial structure and hair color.

Kie wore a purple and cream-checkered kimono with a white and long-sleeved kappōgi over the top. She also sported a white tenugui around her head, which covered most of her hair.

As the mother of six children, Kie was always seen displaying a very loving, caring and kind personality. Since she was a single mother, she always tried to be as warm and affectionate to her children as she could to fill the gap her husband left. She was very protective of her children, but at the same time, she also taught them to be independent. She demonstrated a positive and encouraging vibe, especially during her appearance in Nezuko's subconsciousness, encouraging her to wake up to help her brother through the fight and reminding her to do her best.

At some point in her life, Kie married Tanjuro and gave birth to six children. After her husband’s death, she was left to take care of their children by herself, managing to support and keep her whole family safe and sound through all of the hardships they endured.
